item.title: [ Map ] Forward Velocity - (Challenge)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
WARNING: If you are going to play the map with its music enabled, you must lower the game's music volume all the way down Forward Velocity is a fast paced challenge designed for players who enjoy this kind of experience and want to put their skills to the test. All the resources you will need are available at the beginning of the map. You will have to manage them carefully and survive until the end, fighting your way through hordes of zombies and pushing forward until you complete the entire route. The map's aesthetic is heavily inspired by the video game Sonic Heroes, with a colorful, fast-paced atmosphere focused on the feeling of speed. The map is designed with speedruns in mind, as well as the ability to evade zombies, similar to what happens in the Tank Run game mode. It is one long map, designed for players who enjoy difficult challenges and want to overcome an entire route without giving up. With each update, new sections will be added to the map, making the route longer, more challenging, and harder to complete. This is a difficult map

item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Lima Infection Legacy
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
Description Lima Infection is a custom campaign for Left 4 Dead 2 set in a post-apocalyptic version of Lima, Peru. Explore streets, parks, shopping centers, and iconic locations of the capital city while fighting through relentless infected hordes and discovering a story inspired by Peruvian culture. This is the Legacy version of Lima Infection, originally released in 2025. It is being uploaded separately from the Steam Workshop release for players who wish to preserve and play the original version of the campaign. Additional Contributors Roku — Level design. Cesar Mallqui — Writing and reference photography. Johan Yuffre — Marketing and visual design. Diir.lain — 3D art. Auralis — Music. Nothara — Music. Benjamin Guillen — Music. Leydi Butron — Voice acting. Franco Arrieta — Voice acting. Diego Paucar — Voice acting. Carlos Jara (Charlie Leng) — Voice acting. Follow Games — Testing and bug fixing. Chaos Kansei — Testing and bug fixing. Jean Carlos Luna — Testing and bug fixing. SrLobito — Testing and bug fixing. inflencr.pe — Special thanks. Diego Castañeda — Special thanks. Compatibility This campaign may conflict with other map or visual addons that modify the same resources. Disable conflicting addons before playing.
